LanguageData.SI_ScanningOnDesc: Colonists with scanning priority will intercept faction transmissions. Click to disable.
LanguageData.SI_ScanningOffDesc: Scanning is disabled. Click to enable.
LanguageData.SI_SignalTypeDesc: Select what type of intelligence to look for.
LanguageData.SI_TierDesc1: The cache appears to be a small forward supply point with minimal provisions and light security.
LanguageData.SI_TierDesc2: Intelligence suggests a modest supply depot with useful provisions, guarded by a small detachment.
LanguageData.SI_TierDesc3: The stash appears to be a well-stocked supply cache with valuable resources, protected by an armed guard.
LanguageData.SI_TierDesc4: Decrypted data reveals a significant stockpile of high-value equipment and materials, guarded by a well-armed force.
LanguageData.SI_TierDesc5: This appears to be a major strategic reserve containing rare and advanced equipment. Expect heavy resistance.
LanguageData.SI_TierDesc6: The intercepted transmission reveals a heavily fortified vault containing extremely valuable assets — possibly experimental technology and priceless artifacts. The garrison will be formidable.
LanguageData.SI_QuestActionVerb: intercepted and decrypted a coded transmission from
LanguageData.SI_QuestDescFriendly:
{0} has intercepted and decrypted a coded transmission from {1}, revealing the location of a hidden supply cache. {2}

Raiding this stash would be an act of aggression — {1} will not take kindly to having their supplies stolen.

Alternatively, you could let this information go unused. Keeping their secret safe may improve your standing with {1}.

The cache will be relocated once they realize their communications were compromised.
LanguageData.SI_QuestDescHostile: {0} has intercepted and decrypted a coded transmission from {1}, revealing the location of a hidden supply cache. {2}\n\nSince {1} is already hostile, there is nothing to lose. Strike fast — the cache will be relocated soon.
LanguageData.SI_LetterSecretKeptText: The quest to raid {0}'s cache has expired. By keeping their secret, your relations have improved by {1}.
LanguageData.SI_SignalFoundText: {0} has successfully intercepted and decrypted an enemy transmission!
LanguageData.SI_LetterStashReportedText: You shared intelligence about a hidden stash belonging to {1} with allies from {0}. Your relations with {0} improved by {2}. In gratitude for your help, they are sharing some of their resources with you.
LanguageData.SI_LetterStashReportedTextCaravan: You shared intelligence about a hidden stash belonging to {1} with allies from {0}. Your relations with {0} improved by {2}.
LanguageData.SI_LetterCounterIntel: The faction {0} intercepted your negotiations and learned that you shared the coordinates of their secret cache with another faction. They are preparing a retaliatory strike and will soon arrive at your settlement.
LanguageData.SI_DialogStashListHeader: You have intelligence about enemy supply caches that may interest {0}. Which one would you like to report?
LanguageData.SI_DialogStashConfirm:
Report the {1}-level stash belonging to {0}?

Your relations with {3} will improve by approximately {2}.
Relations with {0} may worsen if they find out.

The stash location will be removed from your map.
LanguageData.SI_LetterTribalTraderText: In gratitude for the intelligence, {0} is sending a trade caravan to your settlement. It should arrive within a day or two.
LanguageData.SI_LetterSlaveText: As a token of gratitude, {0} is sending a slave to your settlement. They should arrive within a day or two.
LanguageData.SI_LetterSlaveArrivedText: {0} has arrived at your settlement as a gift. You may do with this slave as you wish — no faction will hold it against you. {0} hopes to start a new life here.
LanguageData.SI_DialogChooseCaravan: {0} is grateful and offers to send a trade caravan as a reward. What kind of traders would you prefer?
LanguageData.SI_VIP_Desc_Shuttle:
{0} intercepted a conversation between two shuttle pilots. They discussed that {1} had sent a highly valuable individual with exceptional skills by shuttle from the settlement of {2} to the settlement of {3}. During the flight, the route was struck by a solar flare, causing navigation to malfunction, and some of the systems went into emergency mode, forcing the shuttle to land at an improvised service pad for diagnostics and repairs.

You can raid the temporary landing site to capture the VIP as a prisoner. Be warned — this will make {1} hostile if they are not already.

{4}

The VIP shuttle will depart once the crew restores the systems and completes repairs.
LanguageData.SI_VIP_Desc_Psycaster:
{0} intercepted a strange psionic signature through the comms console. The source is constantly moving, and its wavelength is unstable, as if the signal is passing not only through the radio spectrum, but through someone's mind. Triangulation revealed an approximate location of the signal, but the trail will soon go cold.

It may be a powerful psycaster in an unstable combat state.

{1}

Approach with extreme caution: an enemy like this can turn a battle with a single well-timed psychic attack.
LanguageData.SI_VIP_Desc_Mechanitor: {0} detected an unusual pattern in mechanoid radio chatter — something almost... human. The source is surrounded by mechanoids and constantly moving. Act fast before the signal is lost.\n\nExpect heavy mechanoid resistance.
LanguageData.SI_VIP_Desc_Pilgrim: {0} intercepted chatter about {1}'s pilgrimage season. A particularly capable pilgrim carrying a sacred relic has stopped to rest. The pilgrim is accompanied by tamed beasts.\n\nCapturing or killing the pilgrim will make {1} hostile.
LanguageData.SI_VIP_Desc_Doppelganger: {0} overheard two settlers discussing a crowd of identical, heavily armed strangers heading in an unknown direction. Their exact coordinates were mentioned in a military briefing. The doppelgangers have made camp, but they will move on soon.\n\nExpect fierce resistance from 10-15 identical combatants.
LanguageData.SI_Doppelganger_Text: Intercepted coordinates reveal a convoy of {0} identical armed combatants from {1}. They all look exactly alike — clones of the same person. Their bodies are unstable and fragile, but they are numerous and well-armed.
LanguageData.SI_VIP_SpottedText: You have spotted the VIP target: {0}. They appear to be affiliated with {1}. The VIP is wearing distinctive clothing and is equipped with a personal shield.\n\nCapture them alive for maximum benefit.
LanguageData.SI_VIP_SuccessText: You have successfully cleared the enemy camp. {0} learned of your victory and improved relations with you by {1} as a sign of respect.
LanguageData.SI_DoppelgangerFight_Text: The doppelgangers of {0} have taken up arms to kill their twins and become the only one of their kind. They keep whispering: "The first rule of doppelgangers is to kill all your doppelgangers at the first opportunity."
LanguageData.SI_TheOriginal_Text: {0} — the last surviving doppelganger — has gained the trait "The Original", marking the end of their struggle against themselves. {0} is now filled with confidence that tomorrow will be better than yesterday, for only the original remains. Or do they..? Regardless, {0} will now enjoy a permanent mood boost.
LanguageData.SI_Doppelganger_QuestAdjectives: of the Sorrowful|of the Faceless|of the Replaced|of the Reflected|of the Distorted|of the Impossible|of the Forgotten|of the Hollow|of the Identical|of the False|of the Erased|of the Divided|of the Unreal
LanguageData.SI_MechanitorSignal_QuestAdjectives: of the Wandering Core|of Iron Will|of the Alien Mind|of the Dead Machine|of the Lost Mechanitor|of Broken Control|of the Steel Heart|of the Ashen Signal|of the Lone Commander|of the Cold Consciousness|of the Motionless Soul|of the Forgotten Command
LanguageData.SI_VIP_Desc_MechanitorSignal: The entire radio spectrum is clogged with interference from mechanoid activity, but {0} managed to detect strange traces within its structure... something almost human. There is no reliable information about the source of the signal, but one thing is clear: it is surrounded by numerous mechanoids and constantly moving away. If you want to intercept it, you must act quickly.
LanguageData.SI_MechanitorSignal_Text: The signal source has been located. At the center of the interference stands an aggressive mechanitor named {0}. Active mechanoids surround them, already switching into combat mode.
LanguageData.SI_MechanitorSignal_FactionAdjectives: of the Wandering Core|of Iron Will|of the Alien Mind|of Broken Control|of the Steel Heart|of the Forgotten Command
LanguageData.SI_VIP_CompletedText: The threats at the site have been eliminated. The signal is no longer dangerous.
LanguageData.SI_VIP_FailedText: You failed to complete the mission. The signal source has been lost.
LanguageData.SI_VIP_FailedExpiredText: You waited too long. The signal source has faded from the airwaves and can no longer be tracked.
LanguageData.SI_MechanitorSignal_CompletedText: The hostile mechanitor node has been suppressed. The mechanoids no longer answer the outgoing signal, and the battlefield slowly falls silent.
LanguageData.SI_MechanitorSignal_FailedFledText: You left the interception zone without suppressing the signal source. The mechanitor has moved on with his swarm, and the trail is lost.
LanguageData.SI_ShuttleSecurityDesc1: Radio chatter suggests limited security: a few escorts and minimal heavy equipment.
LanguageData.SI_ShuttleSecurityDesc2: Intercepted messages indicate a proper armed escort team. Expect organized resistance.
LanguageData.SI_ShuttleSecurityDesc3: The VIP is protected by a reinforced detail with solid equipment and training. Attacking without a plan may be costly.
LanguageData.SI_ShuttleSecurityDesc4: According to the pilots, the landing pad is guarded by elite security and several reserve combat teams. This is an extremely dangerous target.
LanguageData.SI_ShuttleSecurityDesc5: The transmission describes the VIP as an asset of exceptional importance. They are protected by a hand-picked guard force with the best equipment available. Expect maximum resistance.
LanguageData.SI_PsycasterThreatDesc1: Intercepted fragments indicate weak psionic activity. The target is dangerous, but their abilities are likely limited to a few basic techniques.
LanguageData.SI_PsycasterThreatDesc2: The signature is stronger than normal. Expect a psycaster capable of disrupting formations, stunning targets, and creating chaos in close combat.
LanguageData.SI_PsycasterThreatDesc3: The source emits a powerful and stable psionic field. This opponent may combine direct attacks, mind control, and sudden repositioning across the battlefield.
LanguageData.SI_PsycasterThreatDesc4: The signal is unstable and dangerously saturated with psionic energy. This is likely an elite psycaster with access to destructive combat techniques and rapid recovery from neural heat.
LanguageData.SI_PsycasterThreatDesc5: The console can barely maintain the lock: the source is pressing against the spectrum itself. This is an exceptionally powerful psycaster, capable of surviving a prolonged fight and destroying an unprepared squad with a chain of devastating psychic strikes.
LanguageData.SI_PsycasterFaction_NameAdjectives: Dry Grass|Yellow Dust|Dull Sun|Silent Mind|Ashen Will|Cold Thought|Muted Thought|Burned Nerve
LanguageData.SI_PsycasterVIP_Text: The source of the psionic signal has been found. At the center of the anomaly stands {0}, a lone psycaster of the temporary faction "{1}". Having read your thoughts before you even gets there, the psycaster already perceives your group as a threat.
